name: Funeral Potatoes
subtitle: By Dave
notes: Served at the 2025 Sonora Ward Christmas party.

items: 1 × 10.5 oz can cream of chicken soup

steps.title: Mix the potatoes
steps.body: Mix together and place in greased casserole: **2 pounds shredded hash browns**, thawed, **2 cups sour cream**, **1 × 10.5 oz can cream of chicken soup**, **¼ cup melted butter**, **2 cups shredded cheddar cheese**, **½ cup chopped onion** (optional), **1 tsp salt**, **½ tsp black pepper** and **1 tsp garlic powder**.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.body: Mix together and place on top of potatoes: **1½ cups crushed cornflakes** and **2 Tbsp melted butter**.
